transitWindowDays.description: Days of observed load transits the measured-transit read model keeps (ADR 0014).

transitServiceLevelPercent.description: Service-level percentile quoted against a lane's measured transit (ADR 0014).

minTransitObservations.description: Observations a lane needs inside the window before its measured transit can push a promise later than the timetable (ADR 0014).

targetOnTimeProbabilityPercent.description: Share of the promises of a calibration segment the buffer aims to deliver on time; ONE value for every tier (ADR 0020).

minCalibrationObservations.description: Judgements a segment (tier, basis, node grade) needs inside the window before its buffer applies and its quotes carry a confidence (ADR 0020).

calibrationWindowDays.description: Days of judgements a calibration segment keeps (ADR 0020).

maxCalibrationBufferMinutes.description: Cap of a segment's buffer in minutes; 0 switches the buffer off and keeps the confidence (ADR 0020).

tier.description: Service tier (promise.Tier). CONSOLIDATED is the opt-in tier of a customer-chosen delivery day (ADR 0024): a quote returns it only when its request lists it or names consolidatedDeliveryDay, so a caller that never asks never sees it.
tier.title: Tier

regionId.description: The destination region; absent means every region.

localTime.description: Order deadline HH:mm in the destination delivery station's time zone.

500.description: Unexpected failure (internal-error); the detail never leaks the internal message. A 5xx is never stored for an Idempotency-Key, so the same key can retry.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).
